meta.name: bug-capture
meta.description: Capture a user-reported defect as a durable GitHub issue written in the project's own domain language. Explores the codebase in parallel for context but never leaks file paths or line numbers into the issue. Use when the user reports a bug conversationally, runs a QA pass, or says "file an issue", "log this as a bug", "capture this".

copy.tagline: 把用户口头报告的缺陷自动转为规范的 GitHub issue
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队用 GitHub 管理缺陷，想省去手动建 issue 的步骤
copy.tagline_en: Convert user-reported bugs into structured GitHub issues automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team uses GitHub for bug tracking and wants to skip manual issue creation

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当用户口头报告一个缺陷时，Claude 会将其转化为一个用项目领域语言编写的 GitHub issue，不泄露文件路径或行号。
howto.when: 当用户以对话方式报告 bug、进行 QA 测试，或说出“file an issue”、“log this as a bug”、“capture this”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我记录这个 bug：点击保存按钮后页面没有反应。
say.note: Claude 会询问澄清问题，然后创建 issue。

say.text: 把这个缺陷记为一个 issue：登录页面在 Chrome 上显示错位。
say.note: Claude 会检查重复项并创建 issue。

howto.what_en: When a user verbally reports a defect, Claude converts it into a GitHub issue written in the project's domain language, without leaking file paths or line numbers.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user reports a bug conversationally, runs a QA pass, or says "file an issue", "log this as a bug", "capture this".

say_en.text: Log this bug: clicking the save button does nothing.
say_en.note: Claude will ask clarifying questions then file an issue.

say_en.text: File an issue: the login page is misaligned in Chrome.
say_en.note: Claude will check for duplicates and create the issue.
